title: University of Southampton Malaysia Undergraduate Scholarships
program_type: University merit scholarship awarded at admission (branch campus of a UK Russell Group university)
funding_type: Tuition fee remission / fixed tuition discount (merit-based, no living allowance)
administering_authority: University of Southampton Malaysia (USMC Sdn. Bhd.), Malaysia campus of the University of Southampton
implementing_agency: University of Southampton Malaysia Admissions Office (application, assessment and award of scholarships)
programme_action: Undergraduate Scholarships (Top Achiever / Exceptional Achiever / High Achiever tiers) and Academic Excellence Progression Scholarship, by qualification route (STPM, A Level, UEC) and programme group (Business / Economics & Actuarial Science vs Engineering / Computer Science)
description: The University of Southampton Malaysia (UoSM) awards merit-based tuition-fee scholarships to all applicants of its undergraduate programmes, based on academic excellence and achievement. Awards are open to both Malaysian and international applicants and are explicitly bond-free. Scholarship value depends on the applicant's achieved qualification grades and on whether the target programme sits in the Business/Economics & Actuarial Science group or the Engineering/Computer Science group.

award_types: Exceptional Achiever Scholarship (fixed RM tuition discount)
High Achiever Scholarship (fixed RM tuition discount)
Academic Excellence Progression Scholarship (up to 100% tuition fee waiver, internal progression only)
programme_structure.award_types_detail: Business / Economics & Actuarial Science group: STPM AAA- (or A Level A*A*A, or UEC 4A1) earns Top Achiever Scholarship of 60% in Year 1 plus 20% in Years 2 and 3; STPM AA-A- earns RM25,000; STPM A-A-A- earns RM10,000. Engineering / Computer Science group: STPM AAAA- (or A Level A*A*A*A, or UEC 5A1) earns 60% in Year 1 plus 40% in Year 2 for Engineering, or 60% in Year 1 plus 20% in Years 2 and 3 for other programmes; STPM AAA earns RM30,000 (Engineering) or RM25,000 (other); STPM AAA- earns RM13,000 (Engineering) or RM10,000 (other).
programme_structure.renewal_criteria: Percentage-based Top Achiever awards are stated for multiple years (Year 1 plus Years 2-3, or Year 1 plus Year 2), conditional on standard academic progression throughout the course. The official page does not publish the minimum CGPA required to retain a multi-year award.
programme_structure.intake: September (undergraduate and postgraduate taught intakes); Foundation also has April and July intakes

status_label: Most recent cycle closed; rolling processing restarted
status_note: The 2026 September intake undergraduate application deadline for international students was 4 September 2026, which has now passed as of 2026-10-03. UoSM states that 2026-intake application processing started on 1 December 2025 and that published dates are subject to change, so applications for the next cycle are expected to reopen on a rolling basis. Verify the next cycle's exact deadline on the official Application page before relying on any date.
verification_notes: Award names, eligibility statement ('open to both Malaysian and international applicants'), bond-free status, scholarship values in percentage and RM, programme-group fee differences, international student annual fees in RM, the 6% SST on international fees, and the September intake deadlines for Malaysian and international applicants were all read directly from official University of Southampton Malaysia pages. No award-amount figure in this record is computed or estimated.

application_deadline.typical_application_window: 2026-intake application processing began 1 December 2025; the undergraduate September intake deadline was 4 September 2026 for international students and 8 October 2026 for Malaysian students.
application_deadline.application_period: 1 December 2025 to 4 September 2026 (international students, 2026 September undergraduate intake)
application_deadline.official_rule: UoSM publishes a single application deadline per intake on its Application page, with separate dates for Malaysian and international students. The page states that the stated dates are subject to change.
application_deadline.deadline_warning: The published 4 September 2026 deadline for international undergraduate applicants has already passed. Do not rely on the Malaysian-student date (8 October 2026), which does not apply to international applicants.

programme_duration.renewal_note: BSc Computer Science is a three-year full-time programme in Malaysia; MEng engineering programmes run four years (two years in Malaysia and two years in the UK for the 2+2 route).

funding.scholarship_type: Merit-based tuition fee waiver / tuition discount awarded at admission; no living allowance
funding.monthly_amount_note: No monthly stipend, living allowance or subsistence payment is published for these awards. UoSM states that the unaccompanied cost of living in Malaysia is usually around RM2,000 per month, which is a student cost estimate, not an award.
funding.travel_amount_note: No travel or airfare support is published for these awards.
funding.fully_funded_note: These awards are tuition-fee remissions only. They do not cover accommodation, living costs, visa application fees or insurance, and no living allowance is provided. The only award that can reach 100% of tuition is the Academic Excellence Progression Scholarship, which is restricted to students progressing from a UoSM Foundation year and is therefore not available to external international undergraduate applicants.

tuition.amount: 60% of Year 1 tuition + 20% of Years 2 and 3 tuition (Business, Economics & Actuarial Science); Engineering: 60% of Year 1 + 40% of Year 2
tuition.conditions: Top Achiever Scholarship tier; requires the top published grade threshold (for example STPM AAA-, A Level A*A*A, or UEC 4A1 in the Business group; STPM AAAA-, A Level A*A*A*A, or UEC 5A1 in the Engineering group).

visa_support.note: Not published in official source; additional visa application fees apply for international students and vary according to nationality

accommodation_support.note: Not published in official source; UoSM separately states that the unaccompanied cost of living in Malaysia is usually around RM2,000 per month

bond.conditions: All scholarships are explicitly described as bond-free by the official UoSM undergraduate scholarships page.

fixed_value_awards.amount: RM25,000 (Exceptional Achiever, Business/Economics & Actuarial Science); RM30,000 (Exceptional Achiever, Engineering); RM10,000 (High Achiever, Business/Economics & Actuarial Science); RM13,000 (High Achiever, Engineering)
fixed_value_awards.conditions: Fixed tuition discounts rather than percentages; the official table labels the A Level column 'Scholarship Value (Year 1*)', so the split across later years for fixed-value awards is not published.

coverage: Partial or majority tuition fee waiver for the first year of study
Percentage scholarships extendable across Years 2 and 3 subject to academic progression
Fixed-value tuition discounts (RM10,000 / RM13,000 / RM25,000 / RM30,000)
Bond-free awards: no service bond attached to any scholarship
coverage_limitations: No living allowance, stipend, accommodation subsidy, travel or visa support is published for these awards
The stated cost of living in Malaysia (around RM2,000 per month, unaccompanied) is borne by the student and is not an award component
International student fees are subject to a 6% Sales and Service Tax (SST) under Malaysian government regulations

The Academic Excellence Progression Scholarship of up to 100% tuition waiver is restricted to students progressing from a UoSM Foundation year, so it is not open to applicants entering directly from A Level, IB, STPM or UEC
Exact benefit structure for later years of fixed-value awards, and the CGPA required to retain a multi-year percentage award, are not published on the official page
Published deadlines are stated by UoSM to be subject to change
eligible_applicants: All applicants to University of Southampton Malaysia undergraduate programmes
Applicants entering via STPM, A Level, UEC, IB Diploma or equivalent recognised qualifications
Applicants progressing from a UoSM Foundation year (Academic Excellence Progression Scholarship only)
final_year_condition: Final-year secondary-school students are eligible: applicants may apply on predicted or confirmed grades, and UoSM states it can exercise discretion for applicants who do not meet the published typical requirements and encourages an individual assessment of predicted and/or confirmed results.
equivalent_degree_note: Equivalent and international qualifications are considered. For BSc Computer Science the published alternatives are IB Diploma (32 points overall with 16 at Higher Level, including Grade 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or Grade 7 in Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation), STPM (A-BB including Grade A- in Mathematics) and UEC (AAABBB including Grade A in Advanced Mathematics I and II). Other recognised qualifications are assessed individually.
previous_award_restriction: Education grants and scholarships cannot be compounded: UoSM states that only ONE financial incentive with the highest amount will apply, and education grants are available except to scholarship recipients.

eligibility.citizenship: Open to both Malaysian and international applicants; no nationality restriction stated for the scholarship itself
eligibility.secondary_school_requirement: Entry to the undergraduate programme requires a recognised school-leaving qualification: A Level, IB Diploma, STPM, UEC or an equivalent qualification recognised by UoSM
eligibility.academic_requirements: Award tier is determined purely by achieved (or predicted) grades in the applicant's qualification, with published grade thresholds per qualification route and per programme group
eligibility.gpa_requirement: Not published as a CGPA threshold for entry scholarships; grading thresholds are expressed as A Level, STPM and UEC grades. For the Academic Excellence Progression Scholarship, a minimum average score of 80% in UoSM Foundation results is required.
eligibility.language_requirement: English language requirement must be met; for BSc Computer Science the published requirement is IELTS 6.5 with a minimum of 6.0 in all components, or an accepted equivalent
eligibility.extracurricular_requirement: Not required for these academic merit scholarships
eligibility.leadership_requirement: Not required for these academic merit scholarships
eligibility.financial_need: Not assessed; awards are merit-based on academic results
eligibility.previous_scholarship_restriction: Scholarship, education grant and Special UEC Grant cannot be compounded; only the single highest financial incentive applies
eligibility.enrolment_status_requirement: Applicant must be admitted to and enrol on a UoSM undergraduate programme; applicants must pay a deposit to confirm their place and to be entitled to an education grant
eligibility.field_restrictions: Two programme groups with different award values: (1) Business programmes and Economics & Actuarial Science; (2) Engineering and Computer Science programmes. BSc Business Analytics and Finance & Financial Technology fall under separate published fee rates.

academic_requirements.percentage_note: Top Achiever Scholarships are percentage-based: 60% of Year 1 plus 20% of Years 2 and 3 in the Business / Economics & Actuarial Science group, and 60% of Year 1 plus 40% of Year 2 (Engineering) or 60% of Year 1 plus 20% of Years 2 and 3 (Computer Science and other programmes) in the Engineering / Computer Science group.
academic_requirements.programme_specific_requirements: Grade thresholds differ by qualification route. Business / Economics & Actuarial Science: STPM AAA-, A Level A*A*A, or UEC 4A1 for the Top Achiever tier; STPM AA-A-, A Level A*AA, or UEC 3A1 for RM25,000; STPM A-A-A-, A Level AAA, or UEC 2A1 for RM10,000. Engineering / Computer Science: STPM AAAA-, A Level A*A*A*A, or UEC 5A1 for the Top Achiever tier; STPM AAA or A Level A*A*A* for RM30,000 (Engineering) / RM25,000 (other); STPM AAA- or A Level A*A*A for RM13,000 (Engineering) / RM10,000 (other).
selection_factors_may_include: Achieved A Level, STPM or UEC grades
Programme group applied for (Business / Economics & Actuarial Science vs Engineering / Computer Science)
Progression from UoSM Foundation (for the Academic Excellence Progression Scholarship only)
academic_requirements.holistic_selection_note: These are academic merit awards assessed against published grade thresholds; the official page does not describe interview, portfolio, leadership or extracurricular components for the undergraduate scholarship tiers.

english_requirement.moi_rule: Not published for UoSM undergraduate entry; the published alternatives to IELTS are school-leaving English qualifications
english_requirement.test_score_note: For BSc Computer Science UoSM publishes: IELTS 6.5 with a minimum of 6.0 in all components; SPM CEFR Level B2 or above (cohort from 2021); GCSE/IGCSE First Language English Grade C; IGCSE Second Language or equivalent Grade A; UEC English B3. Other equivalent qualifications, including international qualifications, are considered. Exact TOEFL, PTE and Duolingo score thresholds are not published on the page read and are therefore recorded as null.

language_of_instruction.language_note: Programmes at the Malaysia campus follow the University of Southampton UK curriculum and academic standards and are delivered in English.

application_method.application_route: Direct online application through the UoSM online application portal

Admissions team processes the application and updates the applicant on the outcome; a UoSM counsellor also makes personal contact
Pay the required deposit to confirm the place

English language qualification evidence (IELTS result or accepted equivalent)

official_application_documents.certified_translation_requirement: Not stated on the pages read

language_documents.item: IELTS 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in all components) or accepted equivalent evidence

financial_documents.item: Deposit payment to confirm place (amount not published on the pages read)

Admissions assessment of academic results against scholarship thresholds
Application outcome notification and counsellor contact
selection_process.weighting_note: No published formula or weighting; the award tier is read directly off published grade thresholds per qualification route and programme group.
selection_process.results_timing: Once the application processing cycle for a particular intake has started, applicants generally receive a reply within a week; processing time may vary case by case.
selection_process.scholarship_rank_note: Scholarship, education grant and Special UEC Grant cannot be compounded; only the single highest financial incentive will apply.

selection_criteria.additional_factors: Programme group applied for (Business / Economics & Actuarial Science vs Engineering / Computer Science) changes the award value for the same grade profile; internal progression from UoSM Foundation opens the separate up-to-100% Academic Excellence Progression Scholarship.

degree_outcome.awarded_qualification: Bachelor degree of the University of Southampton (for example Bachelor of Science in Computer Science), awarded under UK curriculum and academic standards
degree_outcome.typical_programme_length: 3 years for BSc programmes; 4 years for MEng engineering programmes (2 years in Malaysia and 2 years in the UK for the 2+2 route)
degree_outcome.degree_note: The Malaysia campus follows the University of Southampton curriculum and academic standards; BSc Computer Science carries course code JPT (R/0613/6/0077) 03/30, MQA/FA 13401, and has professional recognition from the IET and BCS.
degree_outcome.credit_transfer: Engineering MEng 2+2 programmes are structured as two years in Malaysia followed by two years in the UK; the UK years carry a 20% Transition Bursary for students who successfully progress.

student_rights_and_cost_protection.tuition_fee_for_recipients: Scholarship reduces tuition fees only. BSc Computer Science international fee is RM51,450 per annum (local RM44,100 per annum); the 2024/2025 published international rates are RM44,660 (BSc Business group), RM46,000 (BSc Business Analytics / Finance & Financial Technology), RM48,874 (BSc Economics and Actuarial Science), RM47,450 (BSc Computer Science) and RM59,950 (MEng engineering, Years 1-2 in Malaysia).
student_rights_and_cost_protection.application_fee_for_recipients: No application fee is published on the official Application page
student_rights_and_cost_protection.student_agreement: UoSM states it is the policy of the University to issue refunds where appropriate to students who withdraw or suspend from their course, with the refund amount depending on the timing of withdrawal and the programme of study.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.common_services: Education counsellor support during application; the campus states it remains open and speaks to counsellors
student_rights_and_cost_protection.bond_breach_consequence: Not applicable; all undergraduate scholarships are described as bond-free

application_readiness_checklist: Confirm which programme group your intended degree falls into (Business / Economics & Actuarial Science vs Engineering / Computer Science), because the same grades yield different award values
Check your achieved or predicted grades against the published threshold for your qualification route (STPM, A Level, UEC)
Secure English evidence: IELTS 6.5 with minimum 6.0 in all components, or an accepted equivalent
Verify the current cycle's application deadline on the official Application page, since UoSM states published dates are subject to change
Budget for costs not covered by the award: accommodation, living costs (around RM2,000 per month unaccompanied), visa application fees and insurance
programme_comparison_fields: Award type (Top Achiever / Exceptional Achiever / High Achiever)
Scholarship value (percentage across years vs fixed RM amount)
Programme group (Business / Economics & Actuarial Science vs Engineering / Computer Science)
Qualification route (STPM, A Level, UEC, IB Diploma)
Reapplication for education grants if the scholarship threshold is not met
practical_application_data.motivation_letter_strategy: No motivation letter is required for these automatic academic merit awards; the scholarship decision is driven by the grades submitted with the application. Where a counsellor assessment is requested, present the strongest grade profile clearly and map it to the published threshold table for the intended programme group.
profile_fit_labels: High-achieving A Level candidate (A*A*A or above)
International student seeking a UK-degree programme hosted in Malaysia at lower cost
Applicant wanting a bond-free tuition reduction rather than a fully funded package
common_mistakes: Assuming the Malaysian-student deadline (8 October 2026) applies to international applicants, when the international deadline was 4 September 2026
Assuming the up-to-100% Academic Excellence Progression Scholarship is open to direct-entry applicants; it is restricted to UoSM Foundation progression students
Expecting a living allowance or accommodation support from a tuition-remission award
Forgetting the 6% Sales and Service Tax (SST) on international student fees
Assuming a scholarship and an education grant can be combined; only the single highest financial incentive applies
Applying for the Engineering fee schedule to a Business programme or vice versa

risk_flags.risk: Deadline already passed for the 2026 September undergraduate intake (4 September 2026 for international students)
risk_flags.impact: An applicant relying on the 2026 cycle would have no open window and no awarded scholarship
risk_flags.mitigation: Verify the next cycle's deadline on the official Application page, which states processing restarts and that dates are subject to change; contact a UoSM counsellor for the current cycle

risk_flags.risk: Published fee and scholarship schedules are labelled for specific academic years (2024/2025 fees; 2026 intake deadlines)
risk_flags.impact: Award values and fees may differ for the next cycle, so a computed total could be wrong
risk_flags.mitigation: Treat all figures as cycle-specific and re-verify fees on the official Fees page before application

risk_flags.risk: The up-to-100% tuition waiver (Academic Excellence Progression Scholarship) is not open to direct-entry applicants
risk_flags.impact: External international applicants cannot reach full tuition coverage through the undergraduate scholarship tiers
risk_flags.mitigation: Plan finances for the uncovered share of tuition plus living costs; consider the separate Undergraduate Education Grant of up to RM5,000 only if not receiving a scholarship

risk_flags.risk: Scholarships and education grants cannot be compounded
risk_flags.impact: A student who qualifies for both receives only the single highest incentive, not a stacked total
risk_flags.mitigation: Compare the scholarship value against the grant value and claim the higher one

risk_flags.risk: 6% Sales and Service Tax (SST) applies to international student fees
risk_flags.impact: Net tuition cost for international students is higher than the headline fee figure
risk_flags.mitigation: Budget the SST on top of the published international fee when modelling total cost

risk_flags.risk: Renewal conditions for multi-year percentage awards are not published
risk_flags.impact: A student may assume the Year 2 and Year 3 percentages are guaranteed when they depend on academic progression
risk_flags.mitigation: Request the full scholarship terms and conditions from UoSM before accepting an offer

risk_flags.risk: TOEFL, PTE and Duolingo score thresholds are not published on the pages read
risk_flags.impact: Applicants holding those tests cannot confirm eligibility thresholds from the official page alone
risk_flags.mitigation: Contact a UoSM counsellor for accepted equivalents and required scores

best_fit: High-achieving school-leavers (A Level, STPM, UEC or IB Diploma) who want a UK Russell Group bachelor's degree taught in Malaysia at substantially lower cost than the UK campus, and who are comfortable with a tuition-only, bond-free partial award rather than a fully funded package. International applicants with strong grade profiles fit equally well because the scholarships are explicitly open to both Malaysian and international applicants.
not_best_fit: Applicants who need a fully funded award covering living costs, accommodation and travel
Applicants relying on English tests other than IELTS without checking accepted equivalents and score thresholds
Applicants expecting a service bond or guaranteed multi-year funding without published renewal conditions
Applicants seeking a scholarship open to students progressing from a local Foundation programme other than UoSM Foundation
Applicants whose grades fall below the published tier thresholds and who need need-based financial aid instead

database_notes: SUBSTITUTION (per STEP 3 of the research brief): The assigned target, Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia 'UKM International (UKMi)' undergraduate scholarships and fee waivers for international students, does not exist as a UKM-funded award and was therefore substituted with a Malaysia-hosted, non-excluded bachelor's scholarship.

Evidence for the UKM exclusion: UKMi is published by UKM as a full-fee self-funded direct-intake programme. Official UKMi tuition fee schedules for international students on ukm.my give totals of RM59,920 (Bachelor of Business Administration / Economics / Entrepreneurship and Innovation, Faculty of Economics and Management, 6 semesters, RM2,520 registration + RM57,400 tuition), RM76,120 (Bachelor of Accounting, FEP, 7 semesters, RM2,520 + RM73,600), RM76,120 (Bachelor of Information Technology / Computer Science / Software Engineering, FTSM, 7 semesters), RM317,520 (Bachelor of Medicine UKM-UNPAD, Indonesia) and RM552,520 (Bachelor of Doctor in Medicine, FPER, 10 semesters). These are full international fees with no scholarship or waiver line item.

No UKM-owned undergraduate scholarship or fee-waiver scheme for international students was found on any official ukm.my domain. UKM's published Financial Aid page (www.ukm.my/studyukm/financial-aid) lists only Malaysian-citizen avenues (PTPTN, MARA, JPA, YTN, Yayasan Sime Darby, Maybank, state-government loans and zakat bodies), and the UKMShape Finance Rules reference scholarships or loans only as third-party offer letters submitted for fee claims.

UKM's financial assistance that is explicitly open to students from low and lower-middle-income countries is postgraduate-only: the Zamalah Scheme, the Graduate Research Assistantship (GRA), the 50% tuition reimbursement via the Research Allocation Fund (TAP), and the UKM Student Financial Assistance Scheme (Dermasiswa) which in 2024 supported only four Master's and Doctoral students. None of these fund a bachelor's degree, so none satisfy the task's bachelor-level requirement.

The substituted award is the University of Southampton Malaysia Undergraduate Scholarships. UoSM (USMC Sdn. Bhd., Reg. No. 201001029797 / 913717-X, DULN006(J)) is the Malaysia campus of the University of Southampton, a Russell Group university, located at Eko Galleria, Iskandar Puteri, Johor. It is hosted in Malaysia, satisfies the host_region value 'Malaysia', and is not on the do-not-duplicate list.

The official UoSM undergraduate scholarships page states: 'All applicants to the undergraduate programmes of University of Southampton Malaysia will be eligible for scholarships. These are based on academic excellence and achievement and are open to both Malaysian and international applicants. All scholarships are bond-free.' This is the authority for worldwide_eligibility = true and bond_requirement = false.

International applicant fee figures from the official Fees page are labelled 'Fees 2024/2025': RM44,660 per annum (BSc Business group), RM46,000 (BSc Business Analytics, Finance & Financial Technology), RM48,874 (BSc Economics and Actuarial Science), RM47,450 (BSc Computer Science), RM59,950 (MEng engineering, Years 1-2 in Malaysia). The BSc Computer Science programme page additionally lists RM51,450 per annum for international students (RM44,100 local) and states that a 6% Sales and Service Tax applies to international student fees. The two sets of figures differ by academic year and are both recorded rather than reconciled.

The exact application deadline recorded (2026-09-04) is the 2026 September undergraduate intake deadline for international students published on the official Application page. Because that date is in the past relative to the verification date of 2026-10-03, the record status is set to CLOSED as required by the accuracy rule. UoSM states the 2026-intake processing started on 1 December 2025 and that the stated dates are subject to change.

Deadline precision is set to 'exact' because the official page publishes a specific calendar date. No timezone is published by UoSM for the deadline, so deadline_timezone is null rather than inferred.

Programme durations were taken from the BSc Computer Science programme page (3 years, full time in Malaysia, September intake) and the MEng programme descriptions (4 years, 2 years in Malaysia plus 2 years in the UK).

English requirement figures are from the BSc Computer Science programme page and are programme-specific rather than university-wide; IELTS 6.5 with a minimum of 6.0 in all components is the published minimum. TOEFL, PTE and Duolingo thresholds are not published and are left null.

The logo was obtained from the provider's own domain: https://www.southamptonmalaysia.edu.my/sites/default/files/UoSM_logo_v2.png, referenced by the official undergraduate scholarships page and verified as a valid 1648x532 PNG served with HTTP 200 image/png. No third-party or aggregator logo was used.

The task instruction to obtain an official ukm.my logo asset does not apply after substitution, since the awarding body is the University of Southampton Malaysia rather than Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia; the UoSM logo on its own domain is used instead, in line with the rule that a logo must come from the awarding body's own domain.
Cycle researched: 2026 September undergraduate intake (application processing from 1 December 2025; international applicant deadline 4 September 2026).
